relationships.subject: AC1
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, in vivo biochemical studies reveal that AC1 activity is required for NMDA receptor GluN2B upregulation caused by peripheral visceral pain information.

relationships.subject: GluN2B
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of GluN2B-containing NMDA receptor led to the activation of AC1, and the production of cAMP.

relationships.subject: GluK1
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of presynaptic glutamate kainate (KA) receptor is critical for pre-LTP.

key_findings: GluN2B-NMDA receptors form a positive feedback loop with AC1/cAMP/PKA/CREB in cortical synapses maintaining excitation in chronic pain.
Different ACC LTP forms (post-LTP, pre-LTP) and LTD have distinct receptor requirements.
